A `for_each` module block looks just like a resource block with `for_each` — add the meta-argument inside the `module` block and use `each.key` wherever you need the instance-specific value.
The set you pass to `for_each` should contain the exact bucket names as strings. `toset([...])` turns a list literal into the set type that `for_each` expects.
To reference one specific instance of a `for_each` module, index it with the key in square brackets: `module.storage["my-project-assets"]`.
